COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
13.05.2026 WPSS No. 1265 of 2026
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Shivam Rana, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. S.S. Chaudhary, Standing Counsel for the 
State.
Mr. Pankaj Chaturvedi, Advocate for 
respondent No. 2 and 3.
2. The petitioner is aggrieved by an oral 
direction, issued by respondent Nos. 3 and 4, 
whereby the petitioner was directed not to come to 
work anymore.
3. The petitioner was working as a Pump 
Operator with the respondent Uttarakhand Jal 
Sansthan at Murray Pump, which falls within the Jal 
Sansthan, Mussoorie. By the oral order, the 
petitioner was asked not to come to work, and 
further, a notice in writing has also been issued on 
04.05.2026, annexure-1 to the writ petition, 
whereby he was asked to vacate the premises,
allotted to him.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner contends 
that petitioner has been working as Pump Operator 
since 2015 and he cannot be removed by such an 
oral order.
5. Learned counsel for respondent Nos. 2 and 3 
is directed to get instructions into the matter within  seven days.
6. List on 21.05.2026 as fresh.
7. Till then, the impugned order dated 
04.05.2026, annexure-1 to the writ petition, shall be 
kept in abeyance. 
(Pankaj Purohit, J.) 
 13.05.2026 Mahinder/

petitioner.
2. Mr. S.S. Chaudhary, Standing Counsel 
for the State/respondent no. 1.
3. Mr. Pankaj Chaturvedi & Ms. Neeti 
Rana, Advocates for respondent nos. 2 & 3.
4. Let counter affidavit be filed within six 
weeks.
5. List on 30.07.2026.
6. According to the petitioner, he was 
engaged on contract as Pump Operator in 
Uttarakhand Jal Sansthan in the year 2015 
and he is thereafter serving continuously in 
that capacity, however, his engagement has 
been discontinued, abruptly without any just 
cause. 
7. Learned counsel for the Jal Sansthan 
was granted time to get instructions, 
however, he could not offer any 
satisfactory explanation for disengaging the 
petitioner.
8. Till the next date of listing, petitioner 
shall be reengaged as before and he shall be 
paid due remuneration. 
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.)
